Ubiquiti Radio POE-24-12W 24V 0.5A 10/100M PoE Injector

The Ubiquiti POE Adapter is a versatile and efficient power over Ethernet solution designed to meet the needs of various network devices. With an output voltage of 24V DC at 0.5A, it delivers reliable power suitable for devices like IP cameras, access points, and VoIP phones. This adapter features advanced surge protection for both difference and common modes, ensuring that connected equipment remains safe from voltage spikes. Clamping protection is set at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, adding an extra layer of security. With a maximum surge discharge capability of 1500A, the adapter is well-equipped to handle power surges, making it a robust choice for demanding environments. Efficiency is a priority, with the adapter achieving a rating of 75% or higher. Its switching frequency of 50 kHz and an output ripple of just 1% ensure clean and stable power delivery. The device maintains excellent regulation performance, with line regulation at ≤ 3% and load regulation at ≤ 5%, allowing for consistent output even under varying loads. Designed for a wide operating range, the adapter functions effectively in temperatures from 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and supports operating humidity levels from 35% to 95% non-condensing. The compact dimensions of 87 x 44 x 29 mm (3.43 x 1.73 x 1.14 inches) and lightweight design of 99.4 g (3.51 oz) facilitate easy installation in any setup. Additional features include a 10/100M LAN port, remote reset capability, and a convenient reset button, making it user-friendly and easy to manage. Certified by CE, FCC, IC, and UL, the Ubiquiti POE Adapter is a reliable choice for enhancing your network infrastructure with efficient power delivery and robust protection.

Features of the Ubiquiti Radio POE-24-12W 24V 0.5A 10/100M PoE Injector

  • Power Output: Provides a stable output of 24V DC at 0.5A, delivering up to 12W of power, suitable for various network devices.
  • Surge Protection: Equipped with both difference and common mode surge protection to shield connected devices from voltage spikes.
  • Clamping Protection: Features clamping protection at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, ensuring the safety of sensitive electronics.
  • High Efficiency: Achieves an efficiency rating of 75% or higher, reducing energy waste during operation.
  • Compact Design: Small dimensions of 87 x 44 x 29 mm (3.43 x 1.73 x 1.14 inches) and a lightweight build of 99.4 g (3.51 oz) for easy installation in various setups.
  • Wide Operating Range: Operates effectively in temperatures from 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and humidity levels of 35% to 95% non-condensing.
  • Regulation Performance: Maintains line regulation of ≤ 3% and load regulation of ≤ 5%, ensuring consistent power delivery under varying loads.
  • Fast Response Time: Features a response time of less than 1 nanosecond, allowing for rapid adjustments to power demands.
  • Connectivity Options: Includes a 10/100M LAN port for reliable data transmission alongside power delivery.
  • Remote Management: Offers remote reset capability and a convenient reset button, enhancing user control and management.
  • High Surge Discharge Capacity: Capable of handling a maximum surge discharge of 1500A, providing robust protection against power surges.
